definitions.explanation: Sleeping lightly while sitting up, often unintentionally.
Falling asleep briefly, especially in inappropriate situations.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}で{居眠|いねむ}りした。
examples.english: I dozed off on the train.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}で{居眠|いねむ}りをしてしまった。
examples.english: I accidentally nodded off during the meeting.

examples.japanese: {居眠|いねむ}り{運転|うんてん}は{危険|きけん}です。
ソファで{居眠|いねむ}りをした。
examples.english: I dozed off on the sofa.

examples.japanese: {授業|じゅぎょう}{中|ちゅう}に{居眠|いねむ}りしてしまった。
{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}の{後|あと}は{居眠|いねむ}りしやすい。
examples.english: It's easy to doze off after lunch.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}に{居眠|いねむ}りを{見|み}つかった。
examples.english: The teacher caught me nodding off.

examples.japanese: {居眠|いねむ}りしながらテレビを{見|み}ていた。
examples.english: I was watching TV while dozing.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}の{途中|とちゅう}で{居眠|いねむ}りをしてしまった。
examples.english: I nodded off in the middle of the movie.

examples.japanese: {疲|つか}れて{居眠|いねむ}りしてしまう。
examples.english: I end up dozing off because I'm tired.

notes:
{居眠|いねむ}り refers to dozing while seated or in public.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {居眠|いねむ}りする (to doze off)
- {居眠|いねむ}りをする (to take a nap while seated)
- {居眠|いねむ}り{運転|うんてん} (drowsy driving)

CULTURAL NOTE:
- いねむり (napping in public) is relatively accepted in Japan
- Common on trains, in meetings, etc.
- Seen as a sign of working hard/being tired

RELATED:
- {昼寝|ひるね}: afternoon nap (intentional)
- うとうとする: to doze, to drowse
